comparison.objective: Launch a pizza from a peel onto an out-of-reach oven stone; candidate removes four insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Dynamic inertial sliding/release with a long tool versus localized coaxial impact tooling and small-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Pizza transferred onto the distant stone versus four safe notch fractures and complete containment.
comparison.reason: Dynamic food launch and placement do not test controlled component fracture. The record has no landing, deformation, or loss thresholds.
